primary_task: Measure the code coverage a C/C++ libFuzzer campaign's corpus reaches by building a coverage-instrumented binary, running the corpus, and producing an llvm-cov (or gcovr) report that identifies uncovered regions.

requirements.name: C/C++ coverage toolchain (clang + llvm-profdata + llvm-cov, OR gcc + gcovr, OR Rust nightly + cargo-fuzz)
requirements.evidence: Choose your instrumentation method based on toolchain: LLVM/Clang (C/C++) ... GCC (C/C++) ... Rust / llvm-profdata merge -sparse fuzz.profraw -o fuzz.profdata / llvm-cov report ./fuzz_exec
requirements.basis: bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)"; egress_allow includes "archive.ubuntu.com" (clang, llvm, gcc from Ubuntu apt)

requirements.name: gcovr
requirements.basis: egress_allow includes "pypi.org" and "files.pythonhosted.org" (uv and gcovr are on PyPI)

requirements.name: rustup / crates.io hosts (static.rust-lang.org, crates.io)
requirements.evidence: rustup toolchain install nightly --component llvm-tools-preview / cargo install cargo-binutils rustfilt
requirements.basis: lacks: "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co, Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA"

requirements.name: fuzz harness source and corpus
requirements.evidence: main.cc harness.cc execute-rt.cc -o fuzz_exec / LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=fuzz.profraw ./fuzz_exec corpus/
requirements.basis: grants: "local_filesystem" (the user's project in the working directory)

notes: Reading taken: the representative request is a C/C++ campaign; the toolchain is one requirement with alternatives (LLVM, GCC, Rust), and the LLVM/GCC paths are installable from Ubuntu apt and PyPI. Other reading: for a Rust/cargo-fuzz project the path needs rustup nightly and cargo install from crates.io, whose hosts are not on the allow-list, so that request would be BLOCKED (egress:static.rust-lang.org / crates.io); apt's rustc/cargo are not nightly. Unknown: none for the C/C++ path. No GPU, Docker or credential is needed.
